rationale: High relevance for pipeline concerns, as it provides a low-level, typed interface to the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) for browser automation, explicitly avoiding high-level helpers in favor of transparency and full protocol access. The tool is architecturally deep, featuring automated code generation directly from CDP protocol specifications.
limitations: Zero high-level browser automation helpers (e.g., no click, goto, or upload_file), requiring the user to handle CDP method calls directly
No explicit test source tree identified, making verification of harness reliability depend on usage
Relies on external Bun dependency and requires specific remote-debugging setup on the target browser
